system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: During the first main iteration ( k= 1 ), it incorporates relevant historical examples from the Retrieval Agent. For later iterations and refinements, it integrates feedback from the Verifier Agent to modify structure and coefficients.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt content varies per iteration (retrieved examples, verifier feedback); exact system-prompt mechanism not described; prompts in Appendix A not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: First, it performs feature-based retrieval using automatically extracted system attributes such as dimension, time domain, linearity, and topology. Candidate problems matching all features are shortlisted.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: feature-based filtering plus LLM ranking of prior solved systems, not lexical BM25 nor embeddings. Ambiguity.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the Verifier Agent provides the violated conditions and counterexamples as feedback to the Synthesis Agent

tool_call_format.note: LLM outputs barrier/controller expressions; parsing format not described.

tool_count.note: Fixed pipeline with SMT solvers (Z3, Yices, cvc5) invoked by the harness; no model-facing tool list described.

edit_primitive.note: No file editing; agent emits mathematical expressions.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The pipeline consists of four stages: (1) historical retrieval, (2) LLM-based synthesis, (3) two-stage verification, and (4) iterative refinement guided by feedback.
loop_primitives.note: Algorithm 1: K main iterations with R refinements each, verification via sampling and SMT.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: In early refinements (r≤2 ), the agent adjusts coefficients while preserving structure; in later refinements (r >2 ), it performs structural modifications
planning_granularity.note: Fixed strategy recipe; no plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The framework comprises three core agents operating in an iterative pipeline

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Feedback from the Verifier Agent is returned to the Synthesis Agent, forming a closed-loop interaction bounded by a global timeout.
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value: fixed hand-offs between specialised agents.

short_term_state.note: Tracks best score/candidate, iteration counters, and logged intermediate results.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A persistent database stores previously verified barrier certificates, which the Retrieval Agent accesses to accelerate synthesis on similar problems.

self_verification.evidence_quote: it performs formal verification using SMT solvers such as Z3 (de Moura and Bjørner, 2008), Yices (Dutertre, 2014), and cvc5 (Barbosa et al., 2022), checking the unsatisfiability of negated barrier conditions.
self_verification.note: test_execution = closest value for sample-based check over N=5000 points.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The process terminates upon discovery of a valid barrier certificate or exhaustion of all attempts.
retry_policy.note: Capped at K=5 iterations x R=4 refinements.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The process terminates upon discovery of a valid barrier certificate or exhaustion of all attempts.

timeouts.evidence_quote: forming a closed-loop interaction bounded by a global timeout
timeouts.note: per_tool from adaptive SMT solver timeout adjustments (Sec. 3).

tracing.evidence_quote: The Verifier Agent logs all intermediate results, enabling cumulative feedback

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: By releasing BARRIERBENCHwith the accompanying toolchain, we aim to establish acommunity testbed
eval_hooks.note: No repo in evidence; benchmark released with toolchain.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we present anLLM-agentic framework for barrier certificate synthesisthat uses natural language reasoning to propose, refine, and validate candidate certificates.

open_source.note: Benchmark publicly available; no license or source repo given.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The LLM utilizes Claude Sonnet 4 and ChatGPT-4o

first_release_date.note: Only v2 date (16 Apr 2026) in evidence; v1 date not given.
